question: Paytm SDE intern, first technical round (about an hour, virtual, shared IDE, after coding questions on linked lists and BSTs): **What are function overloading and function overriding? Explain with examples.** The same difference question was asked again in a later round.
lookingFor: Precise definitions and the compile-time vs run-time distinction.
Ability to illustrate with correct code.
Understanding of how dynamic dispatch works (virtual functions, vtable idea).
Awareness of rules and pitfalls (return type, access, static, `@Override`).
followUps: Can we overload main() in Java? Can we override a static method?
How does the virtual table work in C++?
What happens if the base class function is not virtual?
Can overloading be done by changing only the return type?
